node.statement: Using q=(sum_{j in B} a_j^+ p_j - sum_{j in N} a_j^- p_j)/(1-sigma_g), we have (1-sigma_g)(q-b)=sum_{j in B} a_j^+ p_j - sum_{j in N} a_j^- p_j - (1-sigma_g)b. Substituting the identity for (1-sigma_g)b from 1.4.3.2.1 gives sum_{j in B} a_j^+(p_j-b_j)+sum_{j in N} a_j^-(b-p_j), which is the claimed algebra identity.
